title: Watch WISN 12's Commitment 2026 Wisconsin Gubernatorial Debate - WISN
description: WISN 12 News Political Director Matt Smith and “UPFRONT” co-host Gerron Jordan moderated the debate, which covered the cost of living, taxes, education, data centers, immigration enforcement, election security, abortion and marijuana legalization.

title: Teacher who survived Oregon school shooting says she had no chance to protect children - CNN
description: A teacher wounded in last week’s attack on a special education classroom at an Oregon elementary school says she never had a chance to try to shelter any of the children inside.

title: John Anderson, Country Music Hall of Famer With Unmistakable Voice, Dead at 71 - Rolling Stone
